# Lumpaz

> > Lumpaz offers designer lighting fixtures including chandeliers, wall sconces, pendant lamps, and floor lamps featuring LED technology, natural materials like travertine, and wabi-sabi aesthetics with UL/CE/SAA certifications.

Lumpaz specializes in modern and transitional lighting solutions ranging from luxury crystal chandeliers to minimalist stone wall lights. The collection emphasizes contemporary design elements, natural materials, and energy-efficient LED technology with international safety certifications.

## Key Topics

- LED lighting technology
- Chandeliers (multi-arm, crystal, transitional)
- Wabi-sabi design aesthetic
- Travertine and natural stone fixtures
- UL/CE/SAA/ETL certifications
- Wall sconces and pendant lamps
- Brass and metal finishes
- E12/E14/E27 socket types
- Modern and contemporary lighting
- Interior decorative lighting
- Designer fixtures (Eric Schmitt, Troy Archive)
- Floor and table lamps
- Hand-blown glass elements
- Minimalist design
- Home decor lighting
